adds.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
adds.text: Selvig reviews the test results Jane sends him as she fights stage four cancer, and on a video call he tells her the chemo is still not working.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: His protégée, whose cancer test results he reviews.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Her mentor, who reviews her test results and tells her the chemo is failing.
adds.evidence: Jane sends her tests to Selvig, who reports over a video call that chemo is having minimal effect and says he is sorry.

adds.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
adds.text: Thor answers Sif's distress call and finds her wounded on Alfheim with her arm cut off. She warns him that Gorr will strike New Asgard next, and he takes her home with him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Her old friend, who answers her distress call and takes her home.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: His old friend, found wounded after hunting Gorr. Warns him New Asgard is next.
adds.evidence: Thor finds Sif beside Falligar's corpse with her arm severed; she warns that Gorr will attack New Asgard next and Thor takes her and Korg back there.

adds.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
adds.text: Groot is one of the Guardians Thor fights beside on Indigarr, and Thor says goodbye to him when he leaves the team to answer Sif's call.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who says goodbye when he leaves the Guardians.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian Thor fights beside and says goodbye to.
adds.evidence: Thor says his goodbyes to Rocket, Groot, Drax, Nebula and Mantis before the Guardians fly off.

adds.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
adds.text: On Indigarr, Rocket snaps at Thor for promising the mission would be a relaxing holiday. When Thor leaves to help Sif, he says goodbye to Rocket.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Rocket snaps at over the promised holiday. Says goodbye when he leaves.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Guardian who snaps at Thor over the so-called holiday.
adds.evidence: Rocket asks Thor why he told them it was a holiday; later Thor says goodbye to Rocket and the others.

adds.title: Thor: Love and Thunder
adds.text: Miek, now helping Valkyrie run New Asgard, is at the docks to see Korg off when he sails with Thor to Omnipotence City.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: His old friend from Sakaar, who sees him off at the New Asgard docks.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Her old friend from Sakaar, whom she sees off at the docks.
adds.evidence: After Gorr's attack, Miek writes Thor's rescue plan in the town hall and then goes to the New Asgard Docks to see Thor, Valkyrie, Korg and Mighty Thor off on the Aegir.
